title: Engagement context record
description: Issue #1173: the business questions a non-technical founder answers once (business, product, audience, stage, intent, constraints), so no later role intake asks again what this record already answers. Lives at clossys/advisor/context.json in a hub (layout approved in issue #1171). Captured through Advisor's question cards (packages/advisor/src/context-questions.ts: nextContextQuestion()/applyContextChoice()), which extend the existing nextSponsorQuestion()/applySponsorChoice() pattern. An unanswered field stays unknown and is never invented. Technical facts (languages, frameworks, installed packages, hosting) never live here -- they come from reading the repository, not from asking the founder. How a role reads it (docs/DECISIONS.md decision 28): never from this hub path directly -- every role, on the hub or in a product repository, reads the verbatim snapshot carried in its own repository's clossys/brief.json `context` property (docs/contracts/engagement-brief.json). The field ids below are also the reserved intake question ids: no role's intake card may reuse one (docs/contracts/intake-question-cards.json `engagementContext`).

fields.description: Exactly one entry per field id below; every id must appear, in any order. A reader treats a missing id as unknown (packages/advisor/src/engagement-brief.ts's contextFromBrief()), never as an error to guess past.

field.description: additionalProperties is false inside each oneOf branch, not beside the oneOf: in draft-07 a sibling additionalProperties sees only sibling properties, so at that level it would reject id, state, and value alike.

choiceId.description: The chosen question card's choice id (a stable lowercase slug, e.g. "software" or "validate"), never freeform prose. The pattern is the enforcement, not only a convention: this record is copied into clossys/brief.json, which is committed in every staffed repository -- including a product repository that may be public while the hub is not (docs/DECISIONS.md decision 28). A founder's own "something else" sentence therefore never lands here, and "unknown"/"something-else" are not known values. packages/advisor/src/engagement-brief.ts's toEngagementBrief() applies the same check before copying a snapshot.
